title: CogSci 2027
about: Annual conference of the Cognitive Science Society, 28-31 July 2027 at the Euskalduna Bilbao Convention Centre, Spain, themed "Human Cognition in the Age of AI". Submissions open 20 November 2026 and close 1 February 2027 (UTC-11); decisions in early April 2027.

why: No course scores at or above the minimum with a genuine match (shortlist matches were word-level only); fallback to the closest Academy page
theme "Human Cognition in the Age of AI" → AI Foundations course A001.24: "Human-AI collaboration: teaming, trust calibration, appropriate reliance on AI"
